methodology: Composite weighted index across 7 dimensions of UAP disclosure, each scored 0-100 based on verified milestones. The overall score is the weighted average of all dimension scores. Weights reflect the relative importance of each dimension toward full disclosure. Milestone achievement alone does not determine the score — the significance of unachieved milestones and the quality of achieved ones are factored in.
